summary: Iteration 4 backend re-test of the two MEDIUM fixes from iteration_3, plus a regression sanity pass. All 9 checks executed passed. Both fixes verified end-to-end.
passed: BUG FIX #2 verified — GET /api/inventory/skus: all 24/24 SKUs now expose 'retail_qty' key (was 20/24 missing).

BUG FIX #2 verified — startup reconciliation: for every SKU, store_qty/floor_qty/retail_qty exactly equal the sum of batch qtys at that location (0 mismatches / 24 SKUs). Previously stale denorm from iter-3 (Creamy Cleanser retail_qty=4 vs batches=3) is now consistent (retail_qty=batches=3 pre-POS).

BUG FIX #1 verified — POS retail auto-checkout via POST /api/pos/upload (CSV with header 'Salon,Invoice Number,Date,...,Type=Product,Item Name=Creamy Cleanser (100 Gms),Quantity=1'): response pos_auto_checkouts=1, retail_qty on SKU dropped 3.0 -> 2.0 AND retail batch sum dropped 3.0 -> 2.0. _consume_batches now correctly updates the denormalized retail_qty in sync with batch decrement.
Regression: GET /api/inventory/template.xlsx -> 200, sheets = [Instructions, Vendors, Opening Stock, Purchase Invoice].
Regression: GET /api/vendors -> 5 vendors present (Kanpeki, Kerastase, Kouyou, L'Oreal Pro, TestVendorX) — upsert & sort still work.
Regression: GET /api/inventory/purchase-orders -> 24 rows, each includes vendor + lead_time_days (plus reorder_point, suggested_order_qty).
Regression: GET /api/inventory/purchase-invoices -> 5 invoices incl. INV-KAN-0724 & INV-KOU-0725.
Regression: GET /api/dashboard/owner -> working_capital=297673.93 (sane, drops slightly from 298650.21 after retail POS sale), sku_count=24, has total_service_revenue/total_retail_revenue keys.
Regression: POST /api/vendors/upload as manager -> 403 (RBAC still enforced).

notes.pos_csv_header_gotcha: Header row must contain both 'invoice number' and 'date' (see server.py:289). Rows with 'Invoice No' silently import with empty invoice_number and therefore skip auto-checkout (pos_auto_checkouts=0). Not a bug per current spec — flagging so future test CSVs use the correct 'Invoice Number' column name.
notes.iter3_low_issue: Opening-stock upload idempotency (LOW) intentionally not retested — main agent flagged as design choice, not fixing.
